name: FMHRemade
summary:
Jump into the world of FMHRemade! Experience full gorilla locomotion as you run from monsters! Start in the spawn and use portals to travel to different scary areas to explore!

From Area 51 to the backrooms 188, every map offers a fun horror experience, or just mess around—FMHRemade gives you the freedom to move like a gorilla and discover cool environments in your own way. Fun, fast-paced, and full of surprises, this is the gorilla locomotion experience you’ve been waiting for!
